integrity: Proof covers every field order and every admissible block shape; finite exact enumeration is supporting corroboration only. The earliest dated reference is 2008-09-01. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional embedded Fq-linear two-sided ideals of the nonunital strict three-block radical with a,c>=1 and b>=2. Does not assert new b=1 results, independent priority certification, unital parabolic-ring ideal counts, or local ideal-zeta functions.
title: Complete ideal-dimension polynomials for three-block nilpotent radicals with a nontrivial middle layer
